subject: website
name: anoni.net Docs
summary: The docs of anoni.net, a Taiwanese community promoting Tor, Tails and OONI, built with MkDocs Material. Its source is public in anoni-net/docs (CC BY 4.0). It runs no third-party code. It is not Level 4: when it opens, the header asks api.github.com for the latest release of the docs repository.

connections.name: GitHub API (api.github.com)
